notes: The Memsic 2125 straddles the breadboard centre gap in columns 17-19. Bottom-half pins (row e) are GND, X out, +5V; top-half pins (row f) are GND, Y out, Temp. This follows the schematic and the circuit image.
Rail hole numbers (bn.5, bn.11, bn.15) and the row letters for the wire ends are estimated from the image. The GND rail is the bottom-half negative rail, bn.
The Temp output (TOUT) is not connected to anything, as in the schematic.
The Uno GND wire goes to GND.1. The image shows it on one of the power-header GND pins.

The catalogue's memsic2125 port names are used: VDD is +5V, XOUT is X out, YOUT is Y out, TOUT is Temp. The two GND pins are GND.1 and GND.2. Which physical GND pin is GND.1 and which is GND.2 is assumed. Both are ground, so the circuit is the same either way.
The USB cable to the computer is mentioned in the text but not drawn, so it is not in the graph.
